events.text: Goal! Manchester City 0, Paris Saint Germain 1. Désiré Doué (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Fabián Ruiz.
Goal! Manchester City 0, Paris Saint Germain 2. Ousmane Dembélé (Paris Saint Germain) header from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Désiré Doué.
Goal! Manchester City 0, Paris Saint Germain 3. Vitinha (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Warren Zaïre-Emery.
Substitution, Manchester City. Iliman Ndiaye replaces Jérémy Doku.
Substitution, Manchester City. Matheus Nunes replaces Rúben Dias.
Substitution, Manchester City. Ayyoub Bouaddi replaces Rayan Cherki.
Goal! Manchester City 1, Paris Saint Germain 3. Erling Haaland (Manchester City) header from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Iliman Ndiaye with a cross.
Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Manchester City 1, Paris Saint Germain 4. Maghnes Akliouche (Paris Saint Germain) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ousmane Dembélé.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia replaces Désiré Doué.
Warren Zaïre-Emery (Paris Saint Germain) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Manchester City 2, Paris Saint Germain 4. Erling Haaland (Manchester City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ayyoub Bouaddi.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Ferran Torres replaces Ousmane Dembélé.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. João Neves replaces Maghnes Akliouche.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Beraldo replaces Warren Zaïre-Emery.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Lucas Hernández replaces Fabián Ruiz.
Penalty saved. Ferran Torres (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot saved in the bottom right corner by Gianluigi Donnarumma (Manchester City).
Substitution, Manchester City. Nico O'Reilly replaces Enzo Fernández.
Second Half ends, Manchester City 2, Paris Saint Germain 4.
